decision_rule: mixed iff calibrated P(mixed) >= t_mixed, else argmax of P(human), P(ai). t_mixed tuned on a held-out validation split carved from TRAIN.

calibration.js_note: After computing doc logits z[k] (classes order as in doc_model.classes), apply the per-class affine transform z[k] = w[k]*z[k] + b[k] BEFORE softmax, then softmax. The mixed threshold rule applies to the calibrated P(mixed).

sentence_model.note: word and char blocks are each L2-normalized separately, then concatenated [word | char]; coef aligns to that order. UNCHANGED from v13 (sentence head frozen).

notes: Sentence P(AI) feeds the 17 aggregate features (11 sentence-score aggregates + 6 distribution features: sentence-length CV, mean sentence length, short-sentence fraction, sentence-score IQR, min, bottom-3 mean). Doc logits -> CALIBRATION transform (see calibration object) -> softmax; the mixed threshold rule applies to calibrated probabilities. Doc model retrained for the humanized-AI class: humanized AI examples (16 styles H1-H17, incl. interview-transcript, text-thread, travel-journal, howto-from-experience, debate-speech) + real human texts passed through a humanizer rewrite (labeled human) as invariance training (DAMAGE recipe) + verbatim real human reflective essays, humanized classes oversampled x10, informal real human writing (HC3 ELI5) prioritized in the human pool, winner selected by a VAL + FPR-probe rule penalizing variants that raise the human false-positive rate; sentence head identical to v13. See REPORT-v20.md for measured held-out metrics and limitations. A score is a signal to review, never proof of authorship.
